links.comparator_used: Same LLMs without knowledge-graph access/SPOKE grounding
links.effect: Knowledge-graph access improved mean scores overall for GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8; no numeric score delta reported in the provided text.
links.quote: Across the 100-task benchmark, knowledge-graph access improved mean scores overall for GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8, though the pattern differed between models; on BiomixQA, SPOKE grounding raised multiple-choice accuracy for both models, without changing true/false accuracy.

links.comparator_used: LLM without access to the SPOKE knowledge-graph tool (answering from its own knowledge)
links.outcome: Benchmark task scores and BiomixQA factual accuracy with MCP tool access to the knowledge graph
links.effect: Mean benchmark scores improved overall but differed between models. Multiple-choice accuracy rose for both models, and true/false accuracy was unchanged. No numeric values are given in the abstract.
